title: Close the month: audit, pay, invoice
purpose: Nobody is invoiced or paid for an hour the audit did not accept. No large sum moves on one signature.
with: Youssef Medhat for the audit and the signed count, Adham for the invoice and the second signature, the company report page for the daily numbers, Moharam for partner facts
when: The last week of every month for the audit. Payments at month end, on our own audit. The invoice after the payments, at net 30.
takes: The last week of the month, then day 1 of the next, then the collection about 30 days later.
needs: The month's verdicts: keep, flag, delete
The wearer log for the month
The daily numbers from the company report page

steps.do: Run the audit over the month's kept footage
steps.detail: Site by site, watchlist accounts first.

steps.do: Delete every flagged session before anything is totaled
steps.check: No flagged session is in the total.

steps.do: Count the accepted hours per site, per partner, and per person
steps.detail: Flagged hours come off first. Youssef Medhat signs the count.

steps.do: Prepare payroll, site payments, and partner payments on the signed count
steps.detail: Each person's accepted hours, minus the handbook penalties, plus the referral and performance bonuses. Each site and partner on its agreement. A partner is not paid for a day with no evening check-out.
steps.check: Every payment has a record: who, what, which hours.

steps.do: Send every payment above the threshold to Adham
steps.check: Two signatures on every large sum.

steps.time: Month end, on our own audit
steps.detail: Payroll with the bonuses first, then sites, then partners. This is about 30 days before the client's money arrives, so the company carries a month of payouts from its own cash.
steps.check: Every payout matches the signed count minus flags.

steps.do: Send the signed count to Adham for the invoice
steps.detail: The invoice is that number and nothing else, at net 30.
steps.check: The invoice matches the signed count.

steps.detail: When the client's money comes in, check our verdicts against what the client paid. Any gap goes to Adham.
steps.check: Hours paid out, hours invoiced, hours the client paid: one set of numbers, and every gap has a name.

steps.do: On day 1, give Adham and Moharam each book's accepted hours against its target
steps.detail: Adham sets the targets. Moharam holds the books.
steps.check: Every book starts the month on a known number.

done: Everyone was paid on the signed count minus flags. The invoice went out on that same number. The close is written down, and the collection is checked when it lands.

fails.if: The audit is not done by the end of the last week
fails.then: Nothing is invoiced and nobody is paid until it is. Youssef Medhat gets reviewers the same day.

fails.if: The client rejects hours we invoiced
fails.then: Adham owns the conversation. Send Youssef Medhat the rejected sessions the same day. The payouts already made do not change. The gap goes to Adham.

fails.if: A large payment is ready and Adham has not signed
fails.then: It waits. The wait is hours, not weeks.

fails.if: Someone asks to move money without a record, or to split a payment
fails.then: Say no once and tell Adham the same day.

fails.if: A worker says their pay is wrong
fails.then: Answer within two working days, through their Portfolio Manager, against the wearer log and the verdicts.
